output.question: What is Uber's valuation?
output.answer: Uber Technologies (NYSE: UBER) had a valuation of approximately $144.42 billion in market capitalization as of November 11, 2026, at 1:09 p.m. EST. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/uber/market-cap/)) This measures the market value of its outstanding shares, rather than the value of the entire business including debt. ([companiesmarketcap.com](https://companiesmarketcap.com/uber/marketcap))

key_facts.fact: Uber Technologies' market capitalization was $144.42 billion as of November 11, 2026, at 1:09 p.m. EST.
Market capitalization measures the total market value of a publicly traded company's outstanding shares.

passages.quote: Uber Technologies has a market cap or net worth of $144.42 billion as of November 11, 2026.

caveats: Valuation is interpreted as market capitalization, not enterprise value or an acquisition valuation.
